column1: # The apps whose preferences mrk keeps. snapshot-prefs exports the plist of
# each app that is installed and has preferences, into mrk-prefs. post-install
# imports it again on a new Mac, into each app that is installed and has no
# preferences yet. Both read this file, so they cannot list different apps.
# One app on each line: four fields, separated by tabs.
#   domain   the defaults domain, which is the bundle id of the app
#   file     the name of the plist in mrk-prefs, at its top level
#   app      the full path of the app, which ends in .app
#   name     the name that snapshot-prefs and post-install show
# A line that starts with # is a comment, and an empty line is ignored. Keep
# the lines in byte order (LC_ALL=C sort), which is the order of the domains.
# Not here: the io.github.sevmorris.* domains. snapshot-prefs saves each of
# them as a group, KeyVault's excepted, and post-install imports each one
# whether the app is installed or not. Both scripts refuse a line for one.
